{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id rows, keeping the highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates('patient_id', keep='first')

# Check the result
print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {trial_df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Shape after deduplication: {trial_df.shape}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
print("\nSentinel values in biomarker_baseline:", trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_final:", trial_df['biomarker_final'].unique())

# Check for missing values
print("\nMissing values in biomarker_baseline:", trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].isnull().sum())
print("Missing values in biomarker_final:", trial_df['biomarker_final'].isnull().sum())

# Check distribution of arms and severity
print("\nArm distribution:", trial_df['arm'].value_counts())
print("Severity distribution:", trial_df['severity'].value_counts())

# Check if arm and severity are confounded
print("\nArm vs Severity cross-tab:\n", pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['severity']))"}
